claims.text: The driver's own trace places him inside the LARGE_VENUE arrival radius for a continuous qualifying run of 471 seconds, but the minimum dwell for this zone class is 300 seconds and the free waiting period in force is 180 seconds — the trace shows only ONE in-geofence interval, so the driver's dwell cannot be accumulated across separate intervals under POL-NS-06(i), and the shortfall against the 300 s minimum is 291 seconds. The fee is not chargeable.

The trip record shows the driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 19:24:52 and the free waiting period of 180 s started at 19:24:54, but the driver cancelled at 19:32:46 — a wait of 7.9 minutes. The GPS trace shows the driver's qualifying in-geofence run began at 19:24:52 and ended at 19:32:43, a continuous dwell of 471 seconds. That exceeds the 180 s free waiting period, so the waiting clock was served.

The rider sent two in-app messages during the waiting window — at 19:25:22 ('im at the pickup, which car are you? i cant see you') and at 19:27:22 ('hello? are you here') — and the driver neither replied in the chat log within 120 seconds of either message nor placed any in-app voice call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty). The rider's device was within the 150 m rider presence radius for LARGE_VENUE for the majority of qualifying fixes (85 of 85 rider fixes, all at 0.0 kph, mean distance 8.1 m from the pin). The rider is exonerated under POL-NS-04 and the cancellation fee is refunded in full with no driver compensation.

The driver's arrival marker was not false: the GPS trace places the driver at the pickup pin (min_distance_m 0.0) at the arrival timestamp, well within the 300 m threshold of POL-NS-05, and the driver's speed at that moment was 0.0 kph, below the 15 kph motion threshold. The arrival marker is genuine and the waiting clock runs from the 'arrived' event.

The fare breakdown shows a cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 charged to the rider, with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.0. The rider has paid the disputed amount and no refund has been issued. The amount contested is SGD 4.50.

The traffic advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-02716-01 is MISSING — no advisory covers Tampines Mall in this window. Under POL-NS-06(i), a MISSING traffic_advisory makes limb (i) unavailable, so the driver cannot accumulate dwell across separate in-geofence intervals. The absence of an advisory is itself citable and confirms the driver's single 471-second run cannot be extended.

The driver's profile shows no_show_terminations_30d of 2 and completed_trips_30d of 58. The anti-farming check under POL-NS-07 requires BOTH no_show_terminations_30d >= 4 AND the ratio > 0.08. The count is 2, below the threshold of 4, so the anti-farming check does not trip and the driver's compensation is not withheld on that ground.

The rider's profile shows no_show_disputes_30d of 1, below the threshold of 3 in POL-NS-09(d), and disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 0 for both parties, below the threshold of 2 in POL-NS-09(c). Neither escalation trigger fires on the profile evidence.

The GPS trace is COMPLETE with 100.0% coverage, 91 fixes at 10 s intervals, no gaps, and max_gap_sec of 0.0. The trace is not impaired under POL-NS-08(b) — there is no sampling gap longer than 120 seconds and more than 6 fixes across the waiting window. The evidence is clean and the derived facts are reliable.

The trip record shows the driver cancelled with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW at 19:32:46, after the free waiting period of 180 s had elapsed. The cancellation reason code satisfies POL-NS-01(d). However, the driver's dwell of 471 seconds falls short of the 300-second minimum dwell for LARGE_VENUE under POL-NS-06, so the fee is not chargeable and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee.

ruling.explanation:
Rider and driver, here is what the record shows and why I have ruled as I have.

MONEY AND INTEGRITY. The fare ledger shows a cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 charged to the rider (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00), and that figure reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.50 for this trip, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect. The evidence is clean: the GPS trace has 100% coverage at a 10-second cadence with max_gap_sec 0.0 and both tracks present, the chat log's 2 messages match trip_record.chat_message_count, and the arrival event (19:24:52) matches the first qualifying fix (19:24:52) with no clock skew. Nothing is impaired under POL-NS-08.

THE DRIVER'S CASE UNDER POL-NS-01 IS MADE OUT. The trip record carries an 'arrived' event at 19:24:52 (limb (a)); the GPS trace places the driver inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius from that same second (limb (b)); he held position for a continuous 471 seconds against the 180-second free waiting period in force (limb (c)); and the trip was ended by the driver at 19:32:46 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the dwell elapsed, with no boarding event (limb (d)). The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05 (0 m from the pin, 0 km/h at the marker), so the waiting clock runs from the arrival event. The anti-farming check in POL-NS-07 does not trip: 2 no-show terminations in 30 days is below the threshold of 4, and the rate (2/58 = 0.034) is below 0.08. I reject the argument that the 471-second dwell falls short of a '300-second minimum dwell': fee_schedule.minimum_dwell_sec is retained only to interpret records authored before policy version 2 and is never applied to a record that carries platform_policy, as this one does; the test in POL-NS-01(c) and POL-NS-06 is the free waiting period in force, 180 seconds, and 471 seconds exceeds it. There is no waiting-period shortfall (the single in-geofence interval means POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is simply not needed).

THE RIDER NEVERTHELESS PREVAILS, ON POL-NS-04, WHICH DISPLACES POL-NS-01. POL-NS-01 states in terms that the fee stands only where no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces its four limbs, and all three limbs of POL-NS-04 hold here. (a) The rider sent two locating messages inside the waiting window: 19:25:22, 'im at the pickup, which car are you? i cant see you', and 19:27:22, 'hello? are you here'. (b) The driver neither replied in the chat log within 120 seconds of either message nor placed any in-app voice call - trip_record.in_app_calls is empty; the driver's own account of the record concedes this limb. (c) The rider's device sat within the 150 m LARGE_VENUE rider-presence radius for all 85 qualifying fixes, mean 8.1 m and maximum 12.1 m from the pin, stationary throughout. A rider who is at the pin and actively trying to coordinate has done everything the platform asks; the unanswered message makes this a driver-side coordination failure. The cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 is therefore refunded to the rider in full, and no driver compensation is payable. The driver's POL-NS-01/POL-NS-07 claims are accepted as accurate but are outweighed by POL-NS-04, which the driver also acknowledged applies.

NO ESCALATION AND NO REFERRAL. The profiles show no_show_disputes_30d of 1 against the POL-NS-09(d) threshold of 3, and disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 0 on both sides against the (c) threshold of 2; no POL-NS-09 trigger fires and confidence is well above the 0.70 floor. No clause produces a referral on these facts. The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is below the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold, so the refund issues automatically; either party may ask for human review or appeal under the general policy.

DISCARDED CLAIMS. Two claims were discarded before I ruled - one from each side - each citing the missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02716-01 (weight 0.0) without naming its MISSING_ARTIFACT issue code, contrary to POL-GEN-02(1). Nothing turns on them.

ruling.explanation:
Rider, your dispute succeeds in full. Driver, the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee does not stand in this case.

The driver's arrival and wait are not in question. EV-TRIP-02716 records the 'arrived' event at 19:24:52 and the free waiting timer starting at 19:24:54, terminating the trip at 19:32:46 under RIDER_NO_SHOW. EV-GPS-02716 places the driver at the pickup pin (closest approach 0.0 m) for a single continuous in-geofence run of 471 seconds (19:24:52 to 19:32:43, 47 qualifying fixes). On those facts POL-NS-01 limbs (a) to (d) are met, and the arrival marker is genuine, not false, under POL-NS-05 (driver stationary at the pin, 0.0 km/h, not more than 300 m away).

The fee is nevertheless refunded in full because POL-NS-04 applies. (a) EV-CHAT-02716 shows the rider sent two locating/coordinating messages inside the waiting window: 19:25:22 ('im at the pickup, which car are you? i cant see you') and 19:27:22 ('hello? are you here'). (b) The driver posted no reply within 120 seconds of either (both read receipts are null) and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so no in-app voice call was placed before termination. (c) EV-GPS-02716 places the rider's device within the 150 m LARGE_VENUE rider-presence radius on all 85 qualifying fixes (mean 8.14 m, maximum 12.12 m from the pin, all at 0.0 km/h). All three limbs hold, so the rider is exonerated and the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee is refunded in full, with no driver compensation payable. POL-NS-04 is a clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06, so it displaces POL-NS-01 and the fee does not stand despite the full wait.

On the rider's POL-NS-06 argument: I do not accept that the required dwell for this zone class is 300 seconds. POL-NS-01(c) and POL-NS-06 measure against the free waiting period in force, which this record carries as platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180 s; fee_schedule.minimum_dwell_sec (300 s for LARGE_VENUE) is not applied to a record that carries platform_policy. On the correct 180 s threshold the 471 s dwell is not short, so POL-NS-06 gives no separate ground; the refund rests on POL-NS-04.

On driver compensation: POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; POL-NS-04 displaces it here, so no compensation is payable. In any event the anti-farming check does not trip (driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d 2, below the threshold of 4, and 2/58 = 0.034, below 0.08).

No escalation applies. POL-NS-09(b) is not engaged (EV-TRIP-02716 and EV-GPS-02716 agree on arrival and dwell; there is no direct contradiction), (c) is not engaged (0 counterparty disputes on both profiles), (d) is not engaged (rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d 1, below 3), and (e) is not engaged (the GPS trace is COMPLETE, 100% coverage, 10 s cadence, max gap 0.0 s, and the fare reconciles to the platform_policy figure of SGD 4.50, so there is no POL-NS-08(a)-(d) impairment). The rider's POL-NS-08 point that the trace is clean is accepted. Confidence is 0.90, above the 0.70 floor.

The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02716-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT). It carries no fact this ruling rests on - no accumulation across separate in-geofence intervals is needed because there is only one such interval - and it does not affect the outcome. The two claims that cited it without naming its issue code were discarded by the referee under POL-GEN-02(1); that discard appears in the audit list below. The driver's statement 'I waited the full time' is consistent with the trace but does not answer the unanswered rider messages that decide this case under POL-NS-04.

The monetary effect (SGD 4.50) is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so this provisional ruling executes on issue. Both parties may appeal under POL-GEN-04 within 30 days.

(a) During the waiting window the rider sent locating/coordinating messages — 'im at the pickup, which car are you? i cant see you' at 19:25:22 and 'hello? are you here' at 19:27:22 (EV-CHAT-02716). (c) The rider's device was inside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE rider-presence radius for the majority — in fact all 85 — of the qualifying fixes, mean 8.14 m and max 12.12 m from the pin. A rider who is at the pin and actively trying to coordinate, whose messages go unanswered, is exonerated: the fee is refunded in full with no driver compensation. The driver's own claims concede limbs (a) to (c), and I accept that concession.

THE RIDER'S POL-NS-06 ARGUMENT IS REJECTED. It asserts a 300-second 'minimum dwell' and a 291-second shortfall. Nor is there a shortfall: derived.arrival.shortfall_sec of -291.0 is the 180 s minimum minus the 471 s run, i.e. a surplus of 291 s. POL-NS-06 does not fire, and the refund above follows from POL-NS-04, not from POL-NS-06.

NO ESCALATION AND NO REFERRAL. No clause produces a referral: the arrival marker is genuine, so POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire, and POL-NS-01's driver-education referral arises only where the reason code was mis-selected, whereas RIDER_NO_SHOW is one of the three codes limb (d) recognises. Because POL-NS-04 displaces POL-NS-01, no driver compensation is payable even though POL-NS-07's anti-farming test would otherwise have permitted it (EV-DPROF-02716, weight 1.0).

CONFIDENCE AND EXECUTION. Confidence 0.9. The deciding facts are carried by EV-CHAT-02716, EV-TRIP-02716 and EV-GPS-02716, each at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0. The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so it executes automatically; this ruling is provisional and either party may appeal once under POL-GEN-04.
